caption: The drawing features a single wooden chair with ornate carvings on the top rail and curved elements along the backrest frame. The chair's wood appears to be a reddish-brown color. The backrest has an oval-shaped, fabric-padded insert decorated with a floral pattern, primarily depicting a large pink rose surrounded by green, yellow, and subtle blue leaves. The seat of the chair is also padded and covered in fabric that displays a similar multicolored floral design, dominated by earthy tones, greens, and hints of red and pink, with a textured appearance. The front legs of the chair are slender, slightly curved outwards, and end in small wheels or castors. The image is rendered within a thin rectangular border on a plain light background. The artist's signature, "Florence Freison," appears in the bottom right corner.
title: Victorian Upholstered Chair
